finding: The board every Insert user lands on draws 3 of the 48 rows its own header counts, with no truncation cue, and leaves roughly half the panel blank — so density, rhythm and scroll behaviour cannot be read from it.

verdict: UNSURE(second element picker with a different taxonomy — merge or justify)

BlockPickerModal.tsx is mounted only by UnifiedSelectionToolbar.tsx:322-326 with position 'child'; the Insert panel already inserts into the selected element via the smart-placement walk (useBlockInsertion.ts:67-80).

finding: The modal board is a 380×225 shell — a title, a search field and four bare category labels, no rows, no results, no footer — and its four categories are not the six the live catalog has.

GroupSection.tsx:225-240 builds a grid-cols auto-fill 128px minimum, so column count is the contract this board fails to state.

finding: The search result rows clip their own source label at the panel edge and drop the element icons the browse rows carry, so a result looks like a different component from the row it mirrors.

finding: Every Insert board pins a tip strip reading 'Tip 2/5' — the product has four tips — and no board anywhere shows what a tip actually says.

finding: The expanded boards give the panel header a different action set from the default board.

finding: The Components empty state's primary action routes to a create board in a review section while a create-component modal is boarded in this very section, so the module contains two competing designs for one action.
evidence: 1138:13394 child 1138:13401 'Panel footer' → 642:3112, which resolves to SECTION '🔍 REVIEW · Templates + Components — 2026-08-06'. 1170:4777 'Components · create (modal)' sits in SECTION 1776:8379 and is reachable from nothing in this module (its only reaction is the walk-chain SELF → 1082:4527).

finding: Creating a component asks for five fields, a variant-set declaration and a token-binding decision before the user has seen the component exist — heavy ceremony for the job 'save this thing so I can use it again'.
evidence: 1170:4777 draws Name* / Description / Category / Tags / 'This is a variant set' with Size, State and Theme property checkboxes / 'Pre-fill from DS styles' / Cancel / Create component. CreateComponentModal.tsx:42-53 holds exactly that state, so the ceremony ships.
recommend: Split it: name and create in one step, with category, tags and variant properties editable on the component afterwards.

verdict: UNSURE(a different panel's screen filed under Insert)

finding: The panel renders a dismissible callout at the top of its scroll that no board draws, and its copy contradicts the panel's own drag rules.

finding: The pinned Paste-HTML row has three failure outcomes in code and no board for any of them.

finding: The module's own spec board states a drawer width every screen in the module contradicts, and asserts a shell for the image editor that the code's cited spec denies.

finding: The spec board's 'five destinations' mixes two different entry classes and omits a real one.

finding: Three of the five rows on the asset-detail board carry no hotspot, including the two whose destinations exist in this module and both point back to it.
evidence: Reactions on 146:2 and all descendants: SELF→144:2 (walk chain), 233:1264→1124:4527, 233:1269→1124:4562, 633:3979→303:1997, hotspot/row Edit image→1124:4527, hotspot/row Optimise→1124:4562. finding: Opening an asset in the drawer gives no way to put it on the page, rename it or delete it — the three things a user most often wants from a file they just looked at.

finding: This board draws an asset context menu that does not exist — one menu component serves both Media surfaces and it matches the other board, not this one.
evidence: Rendered 1717:17203: Insert to canvas / Select / Rename… / Move to folder › / Replace… / Download / Delete. MediaContextMenu.tsx:158-254 renders Insert to canvas / Select / Rename… / Move to folder › / Copy URL / Copy alt text / Edit image… / Replace across pages… / Delete, and its header comment names board 1163:13695 as the contract. The same component is imported by MediaTab.tsx:16 (drawer) and LibraryManager.tsx:20 (fullpage). 'Download' appears nowhere in the component.

finding: The no-results board simultaneously tells the user their search matched nothing and that the library could not be reached, and the red banner physically overlaps the folder row beneath it.

finding: The board that declares upload switched off draws the Upload button unchanged, overlaps its own two banner lines, and clips the footer at the frame edge.

finding: The quota banner's only call to action leads nowhere in the prototype.
evidence: Reactions on 145:199 and descendants: SELF→145:250 (walk chain) and hotspot/back 1672:7219→144:2. The text node 'Optimise images to free space ›' at y=748 carries none.

finding: One board shows two mutually exclusive states at once: four assets in the folder and, below the footer, the copy that says nothing matches.

recommend: Remove the empty copy from 145:49; the filter-empty case already has its own board (1704:8514).

finding: Two 280×812 screens exist to carry one banner line each, with no panel drawn under them.

finding: The empty-library board contradicts itself: the toolbar reports 24 files and a recent upload while every count on the screen reads 0 and the body says there are none.

finding: An empty library still draws four filter chips reading zero.

finding: The launcher footer is not pinned: it sits at six different heights across the drawer family, and one of its three actions is drawn on exactly one board.

finding: The search-scope strip wraps to two lines and lands on the folder-picker row beneath it.

finding: An icon picker is boarded with no icons — every tile is a blank grey square — and the block below RECENT carries no header at all.

finding: The asset preview on the detail board is an empty grey box, so the one thing the screen exists to confirm — that this is the right file — is not drawn.

finding: The stock drill-in draws a loading line and a Load-more button at the same time, although the code treats them as consecutive states.

finding: The two stock surfaces filter the same search with different vocabularies and different scopes, so moving from drawer to fullpage means relearning stock.

StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:10-12 confirms the split is deliberate ('This is the DRAWER's stock surface — the fullpage manager keeps StockSourceModal').

screen: Media · drawer stock — empty / searching / failed / quota (no screens)

StockSourceModal.tsx:113-125 renders the quota strip.

finding: The picker's footer tells the user a shipped feature is not shipped, and the modal carries a tab that is not part of choosing an image.
evidence: 1164:4713 footer text: 'Upload tab accepts image/video/audio · max 10 MB each · From URL launches soon'. finding: The module boards the error state of Import-from-URL but not its default, and three more of its own modals live outside the section entirely.
evidence: 1205:4816 (invalid) is in SECTION 1776:8372; its hotspot/back 1672:7223 → 1205:4804 'Media · modal · import-url', which resolves to SECTION 'Notes · captions & annotations'. recommend: Move 1205:4804, 1205:4829 and 1174:4849 into 1776:8372; the module currently boards outcomes it cannot show.

finding: The most destructive confirm in the module has no confirmed outcome — both of its hotspots go backwards.

finding: Two of the three bulk actions in the drawer lead nowhere, including the one with a submenu.
evidence: Reactions on 145:300 and descendants: 1175:4866 and 1671:7207, both hotspot/state → 1175:4827 (delete confirm). 'Move to…' (y=782 x=100) and 'Done' (x=234) carry none. SlimLauncher.tsx:540-556 renders a real folder submenu behind Move; 1717:17203 boards only its no-folders case, reached from the grid rather than from selection.

finding: The fullpage bulk bar is drawn with four actions and none of them is wired; the board's only exits are the rail and the close button.
evidence: Reactions on 1163:4641 and descendants: pill/in, btn/publish, six rail/* items and 1163:4678 '✕'. The bar's '2 selected · Move to folder… · Download · Delete · ✕ Clear' (y=161, x=328-1052) carries none. AssetGrid.tsx:109-110 names this board as the contract for the bulk Download.

finding: The drawer's door to the fullpage Asset Library is drawn but unwired — the fullpage is reachable only through a prototype state-jump node.

finding: Nothing on the Media boards says what clicking an asset does, and the board wires the click to the opposite of what the product does.

AssetCell.tsx:91-101 — a single click calls onClick (SlimLauncher passes onInsert = state.insertToCanvas) and only a double click opens the detail. verdict: UNSURE(designs an unbuilt capability with no supporting states)
finding: The upload queue designs archive extraction, which no code path accepts and no other board follows up on.

finding: An in-flight upload queue with no way to cancel or retry a row.
evidence: Reactions on 1163:13948 and descendants: pill/in, btn/publish, six rail/* and 1163:13985 '✕' (close the library). 'Dismiss' (y=310 x=1054) and the ⟳ row carry none; nothing on the board stops an upload.

screen: Replace / Move labels across five surfaces
finding: One action carries four names and a second carries three, across boards a user crosses in a single session.
evidence: Replace: 'Replace across site' (146:2 row), 'Replace across site…' (1159:4593 y=808), 'Replace across pages…' (1163:13695 y=412), 'Replace…' (1717:17203 y=134), 'Replace across site' (1164:4738 modal title). Move: 'Move to…' (145:300), 'Move to folder…' (1163:4641), 'Move to folder ›' (1163:13695 and 1717:17203). MediaContextMenu.tsx:243 ships 'Replace across pages…'.

screen: Media · fullpage · library vs drawer quota boards
finding: The two Media surfaces state storage in different units, formats and ceilings, so a builder cannot tell whether they read the same number.
evidence: Drawer: '842 MB of 1 GB used' (145:199) and '1 GB of 1 GB used — upload is off…' (145:250). Fullpage status bar: '84 MB / 500 MB' (1159:4593 y=878) and '0 MB / 500 MB' (1162:4617).
recommend: One ceiling, one format, sourced from one place, on both surfaces.

finding: The two surfaces use different selection idioms and different bulk action sets for the same job.
evidence: Rendered 145:300: selection is a small grey tick at the bottom-left of each card, the cards themselves carry no selected treatment, and the bar offers Move to… / Delete / Done. 1163:4641 uses explicit ☑/☐ checkboxes in a Name column and offers Move to folder… / Download / Delete / ✕ Clear. Download exists only in the fullpage path (AssetGrid.tsx:109-110); SlimLauncher.tsx has no download handler.
recommend: Use one selected-cell treatment and justify or close the Download asymmetry.

finding: The board documents a defect instead of designing the state — it draws the broken screen and annotates why it is broken.
evidence: 1738:8394 renders the no-results copy 'No photos found for "sunset over water"' with an annotation beside it: 'The grid behind still reads No photos found — the product cannot tell the user the difference' and 'useDiscoveryState.ts:110 catches and toasts; setStockPhotos is never called…'.
recommend: Keep the annotation but draw the intended failed state above it — a retry and a reason — so there is something to build.

finding: Trash is a destination on every fullpage board and there is no board for it, and no board marks it as unbuilt.
evidence: 1159:4593, 1162:4617, 1163:13695 all draw '🗑 Trash' in the folder rail at y=826. FolderTree.tsx:420-421 renders the row; LibraryManager.tsx:356-358 wires onTrashClick to addToast('Trash coming soon'). Deleting an asset therefore has no recoverable path in either the design or the product.
recommend: Board Trash — list, restore, empty — or mark the rail row as pending on the boards so nobody builds a door to a toast.

finding: Folders can be created and deleted in the product; only creation is designed, and deleting a folder that holds assets has no confirm anywhere.
evidence: FolderTree.tsx:147-154 renders a per-row delete control and :270 calls deleteFolder(folder.id); the new-folder path is boarded (1205:4829, reached from 1163:13695 row/＋ New folder). No board in 1776:8372 shows a folder rename, a folder delete, or what happens to the assets inside it.
recommend: Board folder delete with an explicit statement of what happens to its contents, alongside a rename affordance.

screen: Asset detail for video, font and SVG assets
finding: The library holds four asset types and the detail panel branches on all four in code, but every detail board draws the image case.
evidence: AssetDetailsPanel.tsx:142-146 branches img/vid → , ico → 64px , fnt → its own preview; :195 shows alt text only for img; :270-280 labels the action 'Edit' for img and 'Rename' otherwise, and gates Optimise on img. The fullpage grid boards a font cell ('Inter-Var.woff2', 1159:4593 y=406) and a video cell ('chef-intro.mp4'), but 146:2, 1159:4593's detail rail and 1162:4617 all draw the image variant only.
recommend: Board the video and font detail variants; dimensions, alt text and Optimise are meaningless for a font and the rail must say what replaces them.

screen: Drawer bulk move with folders present
finding: The drawer's Move-to-folder picker is only boarded in the case where there are no folders.
evidence: 1717:17203 is the sole move-to-folder board and its caption reads 'folderTree is empty → the picker offers (Root) only'. SlimLauncher.tsx:540-556 renders the populated submenu (Root plus every folder from flattenFolderTree), and 145:300's 'Move to…' is the drawer's entry to it.
recommend: Board the populated picker, including its nesting and its scroll behaviour in a 280 drawer.

screen: Media · grid — asset card (shared by 8 drawer boards)
finding: The origin badge on the asset card overflows the thumbnail and is clipped mid-word on every board that uses the card.
evidence: Full-resolution capture of 144:2 and 145:250: the badge on hero-dark.jpg renders as 'STOC' with the final character cut by the card's left/bottom edge. The same card instance appears on 145:2, 145:49, 145:96, 145:148, 145:199, 145:250 and 145:300.
recommend: Inset the badge inside the thumbnail bounds and set a max width; it is one component, so one fix covers eight boards.

finding: The middle launcher button's label wraps and collides with the row beneath it on the only board that draws all three launchers.
evidence: Full-resolution capture of 144:2: '↑ Upload' and '⬡ Icons' render on one line while the middle button shows a cloud glyph with its label broken onto a second line under it. The text node is '☁  Stock' at y=576 x=110 in a 280-wide frame carrying a third button at x=156.
recommend: Widen the footer row or drop to icon-only buttons with tooltips; three labelled actions do not fit 280px at this type size.
